{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Confirm only two channels exist
unique_channels = df['channel'].unique()
print(f'Unique channels found: {unique_channels}')

# Filter for completed orders
completed_df = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Convert revenue: remove commas and cast to float
completed_df['revenue_numeric'] = completed_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_mask = completed_df['revenue_numeric'] == 999999.99
qa_count = qa_mask.sum()
print(f'QA orders in completed set: {qa_count}')

# If no QA orders, proceed
if qa_count == 0:
    total_revenue_by_channel = completed_df.groupby('channel', as_index=False)['revenue_numeric'].sum()
    print(f'Total revenue per channel:
{total_revenue_by_channel}')
    best_channel = total_revenue_by_channel.loc[total_revenue_by_channel['revenue_numeric'].idxmax(), 'channel']
    max_revenue = total_revenue_by_channel['revenue_numeric'].max()
    print(f'Channel with highest revenue: {best_channel}, Total: {max_revenue}')
else:
    # Remove QA orders
    clean_df = completed_df[~qa_mask]
    total_revenue_by_channel = clean_df.groupby('channel', as_index=False)['revenue_numeric'].sum()
    print(f'After removing {qa_count} QA orders, total revenue per channel:
{total_revenue_by_channel}')
    best_channel = total_revenue_by_channel.loc[total_revenue_by_channel['revenue_numeric'].idxmax(), 'channel']
    max_revenue = total_revenue_by_channel['revenue_numeric'].max()
    print(f'Channel with highest revenue: {best_channel}, Total: {max_revenue}')"}
